title: Add Driftpod.fm to video_audio
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Driftpod.fm](https://driftpod.fm) to video_audio
- Press play for endless discovery of podcasts. Users tailor their experience by adding favorite podcasts, liking and disliking episodes, and the recommendation engine gets episode metadata (summaries, 

Fixes #12754

gist.headline: Podcasts drift into bloom
gist.blurb: Driftpod.fm joined the video_audio garden: an endless podcast discovery stream that learns what you like, one play button at a time. Polli brought headphones; the recommendation engine brought metadata.
gist.summary: Added Driftpod.fm to the video_audio app directory, highlighting its endless podcast discovery player with favorites, episode likes/dislikes, and metadata-powered recommendations.
gist.impact: People exploring pollinations-powered apps can now find Driftpod.fm and tune a personalized stream of podcast episodes from the video_audio collection.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Driftpod.fm as a cozy retro podcast listening nook: a CRT radio/player emits gentle floating episode cards and audio-wave vines that grow into flowers, representing endless discovery and metadata-powered recommendations. Polli, wearing oversized little headphones, happily curates the stream by placing heart and skip tokens beside a glowing lime-green player; include a small monitor robot holding a playlist card to reinforce discovery.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-dark-brown striped bee mascot with black antennae, oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, happy smile, small light-blue translucent wings, and oversized tiny headphones, tending a retro CRT podcast player glowing lime green (#ecf874) as floating episode cards and soft audio-wave vines bloom into pastel flowers; a cute monitor-head robot holds a playlist card nearby. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle scanlines, with simple pixel-font text: "DRIFTPOD.FM".
